Hello,

Of course — we'll send a copy of the invoice for RB-20263103 over to you shortly.

On the €300 damage assessment for the scissor lift: I've now gone through this. Once a damage charge has been assessed against our repair-cost schedule and communicated to the customer, it's final under our policy and can't be renegotiated or waived afterwards, even for a long-standing account. I know that isn't the answer you were hoping for, but I wanted to give you a clear one rather than leave it open.

Best regards,
Elina Rahkonen
Senior Coordinator
